scope: One-host original four-node 3x16K same-byte CPU/GPU/CPU diagnostic. Counters and retained samples span process startup through the post-transaction final progress snapshot, NOT clipped to the transaction drive window. No sending strategy or protocol change. Native IO+stage timing enabled; critical/asset trace disabled. Not old ETW, not pure CPU/kernel time and not sustained TPS acceptance.
measurement: Every 61st batch jointly samples 5 independent intervals, nearest-rank quantiles; all-attempt counters are separate; max1024 retained rows. Ratios use SUM durations / SUM matching joint total, not sums of independent percentiles or old outer SocketBatchSend time.

external_sample_alignment.scope: UTC wall-clock markers for an external observer only; TPS and CPU deltas retain their original clocks

cpu.scope: GetProcessTimes user+kernel across all process threads; snapshots surround the original drive call, including boundary-read skew and its tail validation/statistic/JSON work, not exactly the receipt timestamp interval; startup, fixture preparation and later audits/cold recovery excluded; four-node cost is replicated work, not one node; driver includes clients and in-clock signing; not GPU device time or crypto-only CPU

windows_batch_submit.scope: current poll thread; original exclusive Windows segmented batch owner only; nonempty UDP batches; counts all profiled attempts, durations every 61st SAME batch. Independent intervals, not CPU time. Validation, bookkeeping, buffer drop and other gaps remain in total/residual. Vec allocation requests/capacity are not global allocator events. Socket acceptance is not peer delivery. No timing or counters when IO profiling disabled.
windows_batch_submit.quantile_scope: retained joint samples only, nearest rank; last 1024 if ring wraps; unreached/unsampled is null
